_doc: Read by gate 2b of the door (`src/mcgyvr/serving/gate-scripts/02-rig.py`). pooled-slots is issue #46 step 1 (records/plans/hub-batching-2026-10-02.md §4): does a pooled llama.cpp head serving several requests at once (-np 1/2/4, pinned by mgpu_sweep's @np) raise aggregate throughput, head-only and split across rigs over RPC? It reuses rpc-split's instrument (its _rpc.sh: the head on srv1's two cards, a ggml-rpc-server worker on srv2 started and removed by hand, llamacpp:b10644-L3-rpc) and runs every cell in a driver invocation of its own (_slots.sh). Steps: a launch smoke at the arms' window (0-smoke), three interleaved rounds of the arms, their null replicates and the desk read's cells (1-round-a, 2-round-b, 3-round-c), the per-slot context ceiling per -np on the split config (4-ceiling), and desk read cell 2's shared-pool fill again at a pool the workload fills (5-fill, added after round a's D2FILL did not fill), and step 4's refusals retried twice more with the rung between (6-ceiling-retry, added after step 4). It drives containers through tools/runs/drivers/mgpu_sweep.py and never the serving harness, so it is not held to that harness's markers.
